an1.219:1.1: Ānanda’s going-forth with other Sakyans is recounted at [pli-tv-kd17:1.4.1](). He played a key role in memorizing discourses ([dn18:29.3]()), and led the discourse recitation at the First Council ([pli-tv-kd21:1.2.4]()). He survived the Buddha, and his verses are at [thag17.3](). | “Very learned” is literally “heard much”, since it was still an oral tradition. | This set of four qualities all highlight key skills needed for oral transmission. They are found together in this sense at [dn28:12.2]() and [mn12:62.6]().
an1.221:1.1: The exact sense of _gati_ (“motion”) here is obscure. At Aṣṭādhyāyī 5.4.4 it means something like the “course of meaning” or the “unfolding of sense”.
